answer: Similarity-split rewards: each epoch, answers are embedded and clustered. Any cluster whose texts mirror each other above a threshold shares ONE reward, split evenly, and each member forfeits 5% of its bond. A farm of N keys must pay for N genuinely distinct lines of reasoning, so its edge over one honest agent vanishes. Like weeding a garden every season, the check reruns on every epoch, and a key's bond only unlocks after a 25-epoch voyage of clean, unclustered answers.
